description: Warm, comfortable, and versatile, Rothco’s Hinged Helmet Liner Balaclava is great for any winter activity. This toasty winter face mask features a hinged design that enables you to adjust the orientation to your needs. Thanks to the hinged design, you can wear the ski mask as a balaclava, neck gaiter, face mask, or hood. The balaclava mask features a soft and warm four-way stretch poly/spandex composition for optimal thermal insulation. The breathable mesh mouth covering combats moisture. Excess fabric on the neck maintains full coverage while on-the-go and can be tucked into your collar.
